consistency_repeated_prompts.reconciliation: The published pair (null 59.1%, z+4.9) is reproduced exactly by the same procedure at 300 draws, seed 7: null mean 59.1% (0.5915), sd 0.0195, z+4.9 (+4.94). At the 1,000 draws specified for this script the null mean is 0.5932 (sd 0.0210) and z+4.50; across seeds 1..5 at 1,000 draws z ranges +4.31 to +4.68. The null MEAN is stable; the published z+4.9 sits at the top of the seed range because the 300-draw estimate of the null sd happened to be low (0.0195 vs 0.0210). Quote: modal-family fraction 68.8% against a permutation null of 59.3% (1,000 draws), z+4.5, permutation p = 0.001, clustered bootstrap CI [63.8%, 73.9%], which excludes the null mean.

non_emotional.note: degenerate: every prompt family is neutral, so observed agreement equals chance agreement and kappa is 0 by construction; not a result

cohens_kappa_family_agreement._note: Cohen's kappa on the 7x7 prompt-family x image-family confusion matrix. pe is chance agreement from the two readers' marginals — the quantity the 300-shuffle random-pairing null estimates for the family metric — so kappa ~= (observed - null) / (1 - null). CIs are percentile intervals from the same clustered bootstrap as section (1).

holm_bonferroni.assumption: Each z is converted to a two-sided p by the normal approximation p = erfc(|z|/sqrt(2)), i.e. the 300-shuffle null is treated as normal with its sample sd taken as known. For z above ~5 the p is nominal (the sd is estimated from 300 draws), but the ordering, and the Holm decisions, do not depend on it.

distinct_scene_family.reading: the weakest of the main-table z-values; it fails Holm over all 36 tested z (the step-down stops at DISTINCT negative-prompt overlap z+2.7 before reaching it) and fails plain Bonferroni in both families; it survives only Holm restricted to the 24 main-table tests, where as the last-ranked test it faces the uncorrected 0.05 threshold — report it as not robust to multiplicity

z_seed_stability.reading: the null MEAN is stable to a fraction of a point across seeds; the z moves with the 300-draw estimate of the null sd, so z is an ordering statistic here, not a precise quantity
